blind.description: A classical architectural stone post or balustrade pier consisting of a square plinth base, a central square shaft with recessed rectangular panels on each face, an overhanging moulded cornice cap, and a spherical stone ball finial atop a rounded collar. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with realistic weathered beige and slightly mossy stone texturing.
blind.from_above: A square top edge enclosing a circular ball finial centered in the middle, looking like a concentric square frame around a sphere.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly lower-torso or hip height on the figure, around 2.5 to 2.8 feet tall, with a footprint about 1.2 feet square.
